title: Time
materials: Household rhythm sticks or wooden spoons
quest_mission: Join Elias & Selene in Celestia on an acoustic sensory quest to explore Time.
rhythm_ignition: Teacher models a steady 2-minute rhythmic call-and-response beat to 'Time', synchronizing clapping and vocal chanting with the children.
tactile_ritual:
The Hands-On Sensory Discovery:
1. Children gather in a circle with tactile items.
2. Follow the musical cues of Time to touch, sort, and move in rhythmic unison.
3. Pair high-reach movements with deep somatic exhalations.
4. Freeze in quiet stillness at the final chord.

socratic_wonder_circle.rhythm_cue: Twilight Pendulum Sway (90 BPM: Morning -> Afternoon -> Evening Ripple)
socratic_wonder_circle.wait_time_rule: Hold a calm 4-beat pause after every question before inviting responses.
prompts: Clarifying Issues & Routines (S-13): Besides looking at clock numbers like 1:00 or 1:30, what light, sky, and body clues tell us whether it is morning, afternoon, or evening?
Exploring Consequences (S-35): If we skipped our calm evening wind-down routine and stayed up playing late, what ripple would happen at morning wake-up?
Interdisciplinary Connections (S-23): How does keeping steady musical tempo in Harmonia connect to keeping steady daily routines in Celestia?

age_tier_scaffolds.Sprouts (Ages 2–4): Sort 3 picture/object clues into 'Wake-Up Morning', 'Lunch Afternoon', and 'Bedtime Evening'.
age_tier_scaffolds.Pathfinders (Ages 4–5): Explain which sensory clues (sun height, tummy hunger, yawns) confirm the time of day.
age_tier_scaffolds.Wayfarers (Ages 6–7): Trace a 3-step morning-to-evening consequence chain and connect rhythmic beat to daily pacing.

remodelled_unit_refs: Unit #39: Looking to the Future (PDF p.213)

domain_spider.language: Articulate clear auditory phrasing and target vocabulary connected to Time.
domain_spider.cognitive: Identify rhythmic patterns, tempo shifts, and conceptual categories in Celestia.
domain_spider.physical: Gross motor whole-body balance, bilateral coordination, and fine motor finger rhythm.
domain_spider.science_sensory: Tactile exploration of real-world materials and acoustic auditory pitch discrimination.
domain_spider.social_emotional: Cooperative participation, shared attentional focus, and calming self-regulation.

teacher_whisper: Auditory rhythmic pacing stimulates brainstem regulation and synchronizes attention across the classroom without visual screen fatigue.

standards.kindergarten_readiness: Understands relative time durations (minutes vs. hours) and recognizes clock face mechanisms and daily schedules.
